notes: v1.1 adds granular verified_formula / verified_settlement fields. verified_formula=true means the coefficient table is confirmed from an authoritative source. verified_settlement=true means edge-case behavior (retirement, walkover, tiebreak, format changes) has been validated against settled results. Both must be true before any leg can advance past PROVISIONAL. See config/FORMULA_REGISTRY.md for the full verification checklist.

NBA.notes: Full confidence. Formula and settlement behavior confirmed.

WNBA.notes: WNBA_WEIGHTS_ASSUMED_SAME_AS_NBA — confirm from PrizePicks WNBA playbook before setting verified_formula=true. Do not set verified_settlement=true until edge cases are confirmed.

MLB_HITTER.notes: Full confidence. Formula and settlement behavior confirmed.

MLB_PITCHER.notes: Quality Start is a derived flag (IP>=6, ER<=3) and OUTS uses fractional MLB IP format. Confirm PrizePicks pitcher FS formula uses QS bonus and that OUTS vs raw IP matches before setting verified_formula=true.

Scoring proceeds under PROVISIONAL flags until verified_settlement=true.
